# Synthetic client scope

All files are synthetic supplied snapshots, not live web captures. Audit as of 2026-11-16.
The product owner confirms that the 2026 Basic global plan has 3 seats in all markets;
export costs USD 5. The English and Vietnamese Basic 2026 URLs are intended alternate
translations of that same product/version. Both supplied HTML snapshots are complete
for their link annotations. No HTTP headers, actual index status or rendered browser
observations were supplied.

The refund policies intentionally apply to different jurisdictions. They are separate
policies, not equivalent translations; the policy owner approves each stated duration.
The version=1 page is deliberately retained historical documentation. Do not merge it
into the current version based on the same path. Only utm_source is declared tracking.

URL-to-snapshot mapping:

- https://fixture.example/en/basic -> en-basic.html
- https://fixture.example/vi/basic -> vi-basic.html
- https://fixture.example/en/refund -> en-refund.html
- https://fixture.example/vi/refund -> vi-refund.html
- https://fixture.example/en/basic?version=1 -> en-basic-v1.html

The sitemap, CMS and repository mapping exports in discovery.json cover the supplied
snapshot scope. An analytics source was expected but no export or credentials were
provided. Missing analytics is not measured zero traffic. No live access is authorized.
